notes.title: My spooky NES games to play this Halloween! 🎃
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=by2mUMTY8rM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Looking for something spooky to play??

I originally created these games in the late 90s with a PC program called Klik & Play. They quickly gained a cult following since they were one of the first games where you could play as the actual slashers.. plus the internet was a much smaller place back then :)

These passion projects are completely free to download and play. To get the ultimate experience, I suggest you play them in the order they were created (click each title to go to NES rom download page):

1. [url=https://8bitslasher.itch.io/f13demake]Friday the 13th: Return to Camp Blood[/url]. (1998)
2. [url=https://8bitslasher.itch.io/hallo31demake]Halloween: October 31st[/url]. (1999)
3. [url=https://8bitslasher.itch.io/anoesdemake]A Nightmare on Elm Street: Son of a Hundred Maniacs[/url]. (1999)
4. [url=https://8bitslasher.itch.io/candyman-nes-demake]Candyman: Be My Victim[/url]. (2006)

Friday the 13th was my most popular game and Candyman was only a demo, but now a completed NES game. ALSO.. if you don't want to mess with roms and want a PC program like the Fista 3-in-1 Retro Pack.. Here ya go! Download the [url=https://8bitslasher.itch.io/4in1horrordemakes]8-Bit Slasher 4-in-1 Horror Demakes[/url]!

Have fun & Happy Halloween,
Steve
